collection.redistribution: MIL-HDBK-141 is a US Government work in the public domain. US10527839B2 is a published patent; only the transcribed numbers are committed. optiland is MIT-licensed. Every transcription, native Project and evidence extract in this collection is MIT. No source document is redistributed.

hashing.source_input_sha256: SHA-256 of the committed evidence extract, which is the transcription of the printed table: these sources are not single files at a pinned revision, so the transcription is the input identity and the same value the record carries
hashing.project_sha256: SHA-256 of the committed project.json file's bytes, UTF-8, LF line endings, one trailing newline
hashing.record_hash: SHA-256 over the record's JSON with record_hash and record_hash_method removed: json.dumps(sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8, no trailing newline
